subject: Bridge to Commit: adaptive pricing & ops playbook
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Megan Ortiz <m.ortiz@heliohealth.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@heliohealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridge to Commit: adaptive pricing & ops playbook

Hi Megan / Contracts team,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, attaching a concise proposal to move HelioHealth from pay-as-you-go to a short bridge-to-commit that transitions into an annual committed program — designed to keep unit economics predictable for you while preserving runway for your product growth. Attached: usage_Q2-2026.csv and proposal_bridge_to_commit_v1.pdf.

Quick summary (proposal):
- 6-month bridge: 120k tokens/month committed (billed monthly) -> converts into annual 1.2M tokens commit after month 6.
- Effective discount: 20% on committed tokens at conversion; additional 5% step-up after hitting 130% consumption through quarter 2.
- One-time onboarding credit: $15k applied to first invoice as operational offset.
- Price hold: lock current rate for 12 months post-conversion (no uplift >3% during that period).
- SLA: 99.9% availability backed by a credits schedule (we can share the full SLO table in the term sheet).

Asks from your side:
1) Confirm usage mix — we've attached Q2 usage but would like a 1-week lookahead pattern if available.
2) Procurement timeline — when can legal/finance review the doc?
3) Any required compliance artifacts we should prep before signing (SOC reports, specific audit logs).

If this looks directionally right I'll loop in Aditya for the pricing/ops details and Lauren for approval on concession limits. Would love to get this into a signed term sheet within the next 10 business days if HelioHealth's timeline allows.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Attachments: usage_Q2-2026.csv (report), proposal_bridge_to_commit_v1.pdf (proposal)

From: Megan Ortiz <m.ortiz@heliohealth.com>

Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@heliohealth.com>, procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge to Commit: adaptive pricing & ops playbook

Priyom,

Thanks — appreciate the clear summary. A few quick notes from procurement and the product finance team after an initial skim:
- The 6-month bridge -> annual conversion model feels reasonable, but we need a clause for step-down protection if usage drops below 70% of committed volume for 2 consecutive months.
- Can you confirm whether the $15k onboarding credit is refundable should we decommit within first 90 days? Procurement will want clarity.
- We will attach an internal forecast (forecast_internal_helio.xlsx) for your consumption — it shows a likely ramp that supports the proposed conversion timing.

Legal asked that we get a list of compliance docs (SOC2, retention policy, access logs) up front so they can begin review. Timeline-wise, procurement is targeting a final sign-off window between Sep 22–29. Is that feasible on Redwood's side?

On the SLO credits: can you provide the exact credit table (not the high-level) so legal can model liability?

Thanks,
Megan Ortiz
Director, Engineering Operations | HelioHealth
megan.ortiz@heliohealth.com

Subject: Re: Bridge to Commit: adaptive pricing & ops playbook

Hi Megan — looping in some ops/pricing detail as requested.

Thanks for the headroom ask on step-down protection — happy to include a conditional step-down (with a modest reprice) instead of a full termination refund. Proposed mechanics:
- If usage falls below 70% for 2 months, we step the committed volume down by up to 30% with a one-time reprice to the committed tier rate + 8% (to account for capacity reservation economics).
- Onboarding credit: refundable only in the event that Redwood materially changes the service or fails to deliver the recognized onboarding milestones; otherwise non-refundable but applicable against the first 3 invoices.
- SLA credits: attached term_sheet_redline_v2.pdf contains the credit table Megan asked for (we've added caps and dispute windows).

A couple of trade-offs we can offer to smooth procurement friction:
- Extend the bridge to 9 months with a smaller initial commit (90k/mo) if Helio wants more runway before annual conversion.
- Offer a 3% additional discount if Helio increases the annual target to 1.5M tokens at conversion.

Operational asks from Helio: a rolling 2-week usage snapshot during the bridge and a named escalation contact for incident response. If procurement needs the SLO numbers converted to dollar credits vs percentage credits, we can generate that quickly.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Megan Ortiz <m.ortiz@heliohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 15:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge to Commit: adaptive pricing & ops playbook

Team — quick internal guardrails before we go further with legal:
- Discounting: do not exceed a blended 25% discount on committed volumes at signature without Director approval. The 20% + possible 3% step-up is fine.
- Credits/onboarding: onboarding credit capped at $20k unless Finance signs off. Make the credit non-refundable except for service-level failures as Aditya outlined.
- SLA exposure: we should keep credit caps to a percentage of monthly committed spend (recommend max 2 invoice credits per year).

Priyom — please create the HubSpot deal (DEAL-8943) and mark this as a renewal + expansion (upsell). Marcus, please prepare a pricing sheet that maps blended ARR impact over 12 and 24 months so we can evaluate.

I'll review the redline with Legal Monday morning; loop Legal (legal@redwood.com) in the next send. No verbal commitments beyond above.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Megan / Contracts team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the forecast file. Quick recap and next steps so nothing gets lost in threads:

What we agreed to move forward for review:
- 6-month bridge with option to extend to 9 months; default proposal: 120k/mo bridge converting to 1.2M annual commit.
- 20% committed discount at conversion; additional 3% incentive if 1.5M annual target signed.
- $15k onboarding credit applied to first invoices; non-refundable except for service failure.
- Conditional step-down protection (below 70% usage for 2 months) with defined reprice mechanics (see redline).
- Price hold for 12 months post-conversion (max +3% uplift).
- SLA credits and caps included in term_sheet_redline_v2.pdf.

Action items / owners:
- Helio: confirm final legal review window (target Sep 22–29) and upload any additional procurement forms. (Owner: Megan / procurement)
- Redwood: create HubSpot deal and attach all artifacts; legal to generate formal term sheet and DocuSign envelope. (Owner: Priyom / Legal)
- Redwood Finance: produce a 12/24 month blended ARR table for internal approval. (Owner: Marcus)

DocuSign for the initial term sheet will be created once Helio confirms the step-down language — link will be shared in the next email. If you want us to route a draft to Helio's DocuSign/contracting system directly, tell us procurement@heliohealth.com email for delivery.

Thanks — look forward to closing this with a clean handoff to legal/procurement.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.com
